data_fields.name: exclusive_feature_chance_per_tick
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 in 200 (rn2(200) == 0) for court, swamp, vault, beehive, morgue, barracks, zoo, shop, temple

data_fields.name: tick_unit
data_fields.donor_constant: one game turn (moves counter advances once per turn)

data_fields.name: cooldown_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (a feature can repeat on the next turn)

data_fields.name: gate_muted
data_fields.donor_constant: deaf, acoustics off, engulfed, underwater return before any roll

best_idea: A per-tick ambient director that rolls each zone feature at its own rarity, lets only the first exclusive feature that finds a witness speak, and does not spend the tick when no witness is there.
decision_why: Keep the per-feature rolls, fixed order and witness rule; add the per-feature cooldown the donor lacks; use cached zone witnesses instead of a full monster walk per roll (NPC budget).
acceptance: At a fixed 1 Hz tick, a seeded test of 100,000 ticks in a zone with one fountain and one temple (no eligible priest in the witness list) gives about one fountain line per 400 ticks (within 10%) and no temple line, and never more than one exclusive line in a tick.
